newsitem.title: USA: New Allied loses bid to dissolve Country World.
newsitem.headline: New Allied loses bid to dissolve Country World.

text.p: New Allied Development Corp said Thursday that U.S. Bankruptcy Court of the District of Colorado has dismissed its motion to convert the bankruptcy case of its creditor, Country World Casinos Inc, to Chapter 7 from Chapter 11.
The company said the judge's ruling denied New Allied's motion to liquidate Country World's assets, principally land sold to it by New Allied for the purpose of building a limited stakes casino.
The company said that in addition, the court dismissed the bankruptcy case, a ruling subject only to a formal order signed by the bankruptcy judge.
The parties have the right to appeal the judge's decision within 10 days. New Allied did not say whether it will appeal.

The dismissal of the bankruptcy case, said the company, means that other legal matters between the company can proceed in state court, including a dispute including a third party with an interest in Country World.
